name: bitdefender-mcp
description: 140 GravityZone API methods, plus fleet health, billing and incident views across child companies.

bitdefender_base_url.title: GravityZone Control Center API URL
bitdefender_base_url.description: Sets BITDEFENDER_BASE_URL, the Access URL shown under My Account > Control Center API (cloud default https://cloud.gravityzone.bitdefender.com/api; on-premises and other regions differ).

bitdefender_api_key.title: GravityZone API key
bitdefender_api_key.description: Sets BITDEFENDER_API_KEY for the Bitdefender GravityZone MCP server. Get a credential from https://www.bitdefender.com/business/support/en/77209-125277-public-api.html.

bitdefender_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
bitdefender_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

bitdefender_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
bitdefender_mcp_read_only.description: Set to exactly 1 so bitdefender_execute runs only GravityZone read methods and refuses writes and the Credential-tier reads (incident reads stay allowed). Leave blank for full access.

bitdefender_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
bitdefender_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not enforced by this connector: there are no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here does not limit which companies a call can reach. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, enable fewer API areas on the key or turn on the read-only MCP server.
